problem: Test a mechanism distinct from rejected Range Onset, time-bar impulse, sweep, absorption, flow-exhaustion, and cross-asset residual families: persistent aggressor flow sampled in fixed event time may continue far enough to overcome executable spread, fees, and adverse slippage.

pre_registered_contract.threshold_rule: calibration 90th and 10th percentiles; frozen before development outcomes
pre_registered_contract.decision_price: first SOL BBO snapshot at or after the event-bar terminal trade
pre_registered_contract.exit_price: first SOL BBO snapshot at or after the frozen elapsed horizon
pre_registered_contract.searched_set_definition: four frozen horizons multiplied by two symmetric sides
pre_registered_contract.advance_rule: A side and horizon must have positive mean after nominal and stress costs in every development fold, positive worst-fold performance, and nonnegative fold performance after removing the largest winner.
pre_registered_contract.validation_access_rule: Do not evaluate validation unless the development advance rule passes.

data_quality.handling: Stale as-of matches were excluded. No interpolation or stale BBO was allowed to affect economic results.
data_quality.failure_discovered: An unrestricted as-of probe produced absurd October profits from multi-day stale quotes. The production triage was rerun with the frozen one-second freshness requirement.

decision.reason: No side/horizon was positive in every development fold under nominal or stress friction. Apparent pooled gains at 15-60 minutes were concentrated in the October crash fold and reversed after fold-level and largest-winner analysis.
decision.live_recommendation: Do not route, shadow-promote, tune, invert, or add order-book gates to this exact event-flow family.
decision.anti_circular_rule: Changing the flow direction, threshold, event-bar size, horizon, or adding book conditions after these outcomes creates a new counted trial family and cannot inherit this result.

confidence.basis: The signal was calibrated before development, both directions and four horizons were retained, executable BBO quotes and explicit costs were used, stale quote paths were excluded, and fold-level plus largest-winner diagnostics contradicted pooled outlier gains.
confidence.limits: The result does not reject every event-time or market-microstructure strategy. It rejects this frozen SOL fixed-dollar aggressor-flow continuation mapping.

falsifiers: A reproducible query or code review finds a causality, bar-allocation, BBO-direction, fee, or fold-boundary defect that changes every development fold to positive.
An independently preregistered mechanism with a different economic mapping survives its own development and validation after executable costs.
Exact missing L2 recovery materially changes the fail-closed fold results without post-outcome parameter changes.
